notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.19.4 — adds a per-message Copy button under every user and assistant message in both the main workspace chat (including the read-only project view) and the Sidekick assistant. Copying uses the existing clipboard infrastructure and copies only the message body (never the author, timestamps, attachments or other UI chrome), with a brief 'Copied' confirmation. Standard Mode, agents and providers are unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V2) with the production certificate.
